cards.headline: Doué puts PSG 1-0 up at half-time after Yamal loses the ball
cards.summary: Désiré Doué scored in the 38th minute to give Paris Saint-Germain a 1-0 lead over Barcelona at the interval in the Champions League at the Parc des Princes. The goal came after Lamine Yamal gave the ball away. João Neves headed it on and Doué cut inside before beating Joan García from the edge of the box.
cards.body: PSG led at half-time for the first time Barça have trailed at the break this season. Doué, who scored at Manchester City last week, now has goals in consecutive Champions League games. SPORT and Mundo Deportivo both led with the half-time score and noted Barça had created several chances before the break. Joan García made a series of stops, including from Ferran Torres and Fabián Ruiz. Cancelo was booked early for a foul on Doué. The match is the third in the league phase. Both sides entered with six points. A defeat would end Barça’s run of eleven wins. The Clásico follows on Sunday at Spotify Camp Nou.

cards.headline: Yamal’s loose pass sets up Doué’s opener for the European champions
cards.summary: Lamine Yamal played a loose pass in the 38th minute that João Neves headed down to Désiré Doué. The PSG forward cut onto his right foot and curled the ball past Joan García. It was the first time this season Barça have gone into half-time behind.
cards.body: Fabrizio Romano posted the sequence and noted Doué now has four goal contributions in his last three games. The 19-year-old Yamal had been involved in several attacking moves earlier. SPORT described the first half as frantic. Barça created openings through Pedri and Fermín after Olmo went off. The error was the decisive moment in a half where possession was even. Flick’s side had not trailed at the interval in any of their previous eleven matches. The Clásico is five days later. Yamal was taken off early against Betis to avoid a booking that would have ruled him out of the Madrid game.

cards.headline: Dani Olmo forced off after 26 minutes with an ankle issue
cards.summary: Dani Olmo came off in the 26th minute after a challenge with Vitinha. Fermín López replaced him. It was the second early injury of the night after Ousmane Dembélé left the pitch for PSG. Olmo had started in the midfield three alongside Bernal and Pedri.
cards.body: NBC Sports and ESPN both reported the substitution. Olmo had a shot blocked earlier in the half. Fermín, who scored at Galatasaray last week, came on and nearly equalised shortly after Doué’s goal when Pedri put him through. The change left Barça without one of their more advanced midfield options at a moment when they needed to respond. Flick has used Fermín regularly this season. The Clásico on Sunday will test the depth further if Olmo cannot recover quickly. Eric García and Jules Koundé were already absent.

cards.headline: Dembélé limps off early for PSG with a thigh problem
cards.summary: Ousmane Dembélé came off in the 20th minute clutching the back of his left thigh. Ferran Torres replaced him. The Ballon d’Or winner had been starting regularly for Luis Enrique. PSG were already without Nuno Mendes.
cards.body: The Associated Press reported Dembélé signalled to the bench and asked to come off after a run down the left. Torres, who played for Barça until 2025, entered and had a chance saved by Joan García. Luis Enrique has managed Dembélé’s minutes carefully this season after previous setbacks. The early exit removes PSG’s main central threat and shifts the attacking load onto Doué and Kvaratskhelia. Barça’s own injury list already includes Eric García, Koundé and Christensen. The second half will test both benches.

cards.headline: Joan García makes eight saves in the first half to keep Barça in it
cards.summary: Joan García made eight saves in the opening 45 minutes against Paris Saint-Germain, the most by a Barcelona goalkeeper in a Champions League half since records were tracked this way. Squawka and Sofascore both highlighted the figure. He prevented an estimated 1.23 goals.
cards.body: García stopped efforts from Ferran Torres, Fabián Ruiz and others as PSG attacked the spaces left by Barça’s high line. The 25-year-old, signed from Espanyol in 2025, has been the first-choice goalkeeper this season. His performance kept the score at 1-0 at the break despite the defensive absences of Koundé and Eric García. SPORT called it a great display. The Clásico on Sunday will again demand a strong showing if the back line remains thin. Cubarsí and Martín started in central defence.

cards.headline: Barça start without Koundé and Eric García as Cubarsí anchors the defence
cards.summary: Hansi Flick named a defence of Cancelo, Cubarsí, Gerard Martín and Xavi Espart against PSG. Eric García is out for three to four weeks and Jules Koundé misses the match with an ankle sprain. Àlex Campos was on the bench.
cards.body: The starting XI had Joan García in goal and a midfield of Bernal, Pedri and Olmo, with Yamal, Gordon and Raphinha up front. Campos, the 18-year-old from Barça Atlètic, was included in the 23-man squad published on Monday. Flick said before the game that Rodri could cover in defence if needed. The absences leave Cubarsí as the only fully fit regular centre-back. The Clásico against Real Madrid is on 25 October. Any further problems would force more changes for Sunday.

cards.headline: Raphinha starts as planned after Flick confirmed his return on Monday
cards.summary: Raphinha was named in the starting eleven against PSG after Hansi Flick said on Monday that the Brazilian would start. He had returned as a substitute at Betis and equalled Neymar’s appearance total for the club. He leads the attack with Yamal and Gordon.
cards.body: Flick told reporters at the Parc des Princes that Raphinha had recovered from the hamstring issue picked up on Brazil duty. The forward has 14 goals and three assists in nine games this season. SPORT and Fabrizio Romano both carried the confirmation on Monday. His inclusion gives Flick a more familiar front three. The match is a test before the Clásico. Raphinha missed the Getafe and Galatasaray fixtures. The second half will show how much he can influence the game after the early injury to Olmo.

cards.headline: Clásico on Sunday still the bigger date as Barça trail at the break
cards.summary: The Champions League match against PSG is the last fixture before the Clásico at Spotify Camp Nou on 25 October. Barça lead La Liga after nine wins from nine. Real Madrid sit third. Vinícius is banned for the league game after his red card against Atlético.
cards.body: Flick has spoken all week about treating each game in turn. A defeat in Paris would end the winning run and hand PSG the advantage in the league phase. The defensive absences of Koundé and Eric García already complicate the Madrid fixture. The German said after the Betis win that the attitude has been first-class. The result tonight will shape the mood heading into the weekend. Both clubs have perfect records in the competition so far. The Parc des Princes has not been a happy hunting ground for Barça in recent seasons.
